processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Cylindrical specimen (Ø 8 mm × 12 mm) heated to 1200 °C at a rate of 10 °C/s.
Homogenized by holding at 1200 °C for 120 s.
Cooled from 1200 °C to the set deformation temperature of 1100 °C at 5 °C/s.
Held 15 s at the set temperature (1100 °C) before compression so the temperature difference between the inside and outside of the sample was the same.

Isothermal constant strain rate compression at 0.1 s⁻¹ to 60% compression (true strain 0.92). Mica foils with high-temperature lubricants affixed to both end faces to reduce friction/deformation non-uniformity. This sample is panel (b) of Fig. 9 at T = 1100 °C, ε̇ = 0.1 s⁻¹.
After compression the sample was sprayed with water to cool the steel down.

measurement_conditions.environment: isothermal constant-strain-rate hot compression (Gleeble-3500 thermo-mechanical simulator)

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: True stress–true strain curve at 1100 °C / 0.1 s⁻¹ rises to a peak near 100 MPa then softens to an almost flat plateau (Fig. 3(b))

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: 60% compression (true strain 0.92); peak flow stress from true stress–true strain curve

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: large polygonal grains, individual grains spanning roughly one to a few times the 100 µm scale bar

structures.overall_structure: Initial microstructure of the as-forged Fe–Mn–Al–C steel: large polygonal grains delimited by a bright, continuous, slightly etched boundary network with dark grey grain interiors, containing abundant fine, closely spaced, parallel light-grey striations (dendritic/interdendritic segregation banding rather than a uniform solid solution). Isolated grains are almost featureless while others are densely striped, indicating chemical heterogeneity.

structures.microstructure_counts: 3 deformation zones (1 difficult deformation zone, 2 small deformation zone, 3 large deformation zone)

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: large grains with straight, annealing-twin-like boundaries
similar to zone 1 but slightly finer mixed structure
strongly elongated, banded/flattened grain structure of flattened original grains with fine grains between the bands (partial DRX)

microstructure_list.region: large deformation zone (zone 3, core of the compressed sample)

structures.overall_structure: Microstructure after 60% compression at 1100 °C and 0.1 s⁻¹ (Fig. 9(b)), observed in three deformation zones of the sectioned specimen; the degree of dynamic recrystallization follows the order zone 3 (large deformation) > zone 2 (small deformation) > zone 1 (difficult deformation). With decreasing strain rate the recrystallized grains grew and the degree of microstructure heterogeneity improved relative to the higher-strain-rate condition.
